Privacy

This site uses no advertising trackers, analytics, cookies, accounts or location requests. It can save your language and appearance choices in browser storage. The sample recommendation runs on this page.

The hosting provider receives ordinary web requests. External documentation and issue trackers have their own privacy terms. Clear site data in your browser to remove saved preferences.

Problem drafts stay in this tab’s session storage until you clear them, close the tab, or receive a confirmed submission. Email addresses are excluded from saved drafts. Newsletter signup is separate.
